shots.detail_en: CH stands mid-hall at nine sharp as the red cloth drops, unveiling giant golden board characters: the Return Rally begins today.
CH turns as Retail Investor A climbs onto a chair, screaming at a great board gone red from edge to edge.
shots.sub: 红了！全红了！十年没见过这么红！
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: RED sweeps her raised ledger down the soaring columns of the great board, her pupils shrinking to abacus beads.
shots.sub: 开盘三分钟，成交笔数十年新高——这笔账，烫手。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: MANCANG is flattened between bodies in the counter crush, holding his buy slips high above the tide of heads.
shots.sub: 别挤！我叫满仓——不是让你们把我挤成仓底！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH watches the Lianhua Industrial cell climb and climb, his eyes going colder with every tick.
shots.sub: 这根大阳线没有下影——影子都被人藏进了夜里。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG's father shoves through the hall crush clutching his bankbook and tin, eyes drinking the climbing red numbers.
shots.speaker: 满仓爹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG's father slides the bankbook and the tin through the counter slot in one push, knuckles white on the brass grille.
shots.speaker: 满仓爹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG's father laughs like a twenty-year-old in slow motion as the all-in slip prints out and red board light washes his face.
MANCANG slaps his own order down at the next window, chest puffed like a rooster.
shots.sub: 满仓！我说过我叫满仓——今天连名字都是仓位！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH stares up at the closing board as the hall's roar fades to a hum around him.
shots.sub: 一根顶到天花板的大阳线——天花板上面，从来都是空的。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: XIONG opens his eyes in a dark blue studio as the red ON AIR light of the live truth interview burns above him.
XIONG ignores the host's silhouette offering the mic and stares straight down the camera lens instead.
XIONG leans in slow, letting each word drop like a coin into a well: this is no return — it is the opening of the biggest bear market in ten years.
shots.sub: 这不是回归——这是十年来，最大的一场熊市的开端。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: XIONG leans back until the light leaves half his face in shadow, hands folded like a resting executioner.
shots.sub: 市场惩罚的，从来是贪婪的人——我，只是市场的一只手。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: XIONG's face multiplies across the night city as the camera pans over lit windows and cha chaan teng TV walls all carrying the same broadcast.
MANCANG's father sits frozen before his boxy TV as the remote slips from his fingers onto the bankbook in his lap.
XIONG stands in the dark VIP box like a cut-paper silhouette, tea steam rising straight as a rope while red circles bloom one by one across his ledger.
CH steps into the old hall next morning and stops dead — the giant board has gone a full wall of green overnight.
MANCANG grabs the counter edge as the stampede hits, sell slips whirling like a paper storm while Retail Investor B screams into the crush.
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: RED hugs her ledger to her chest, knuckles white, refusing to let the crowd jostle a single page loose.
shots.sub: 开盘十分钟，跌掉的数字——够把这条街买十遍。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH stands still in the middle of the fleeing current, face turned up toward the dark VIP box.
shots.sub: 他说出口的那一刻，熊市才真正开始——嘴，才是最大的筹码。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG's eyes run down the freshly inked 'trapped list' taped to the cha chaan teng wall and lock dead on the third name — his father's.
MANCANG stands frozen at the doorway as his father's back shakes in the static-glow of the dark room — the first time in his life he has seen his father cry.
shots.sub: 他说过的……他上过电视啊。
shots.speaker: 满仓爹

shots.detail_en: CH stands alone in the dead hall at midnight, green light pulsing on his face as the gold line finally leaves his mouth.
shots.sub: 牛市没有眼泪，熊市也没有——市场从头到尾，只发账单。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH's voice cuts across a black screen as bold white characters bloom: 'Next — The First Shot.'
shots.sub: 熊先生说，他是市场的一只手——那我就去做另一只。
shots.speaker: 长虹（画外）
